name: Regency Centers

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Regency Centers Corporation logo.svg)

description: Regency owns, operates and develops neighborhood and community shopping centers anchored mainly by market-leading grocers in suburban trade areas: full or partial interests in 481 properties and about 58.4 million sq ft of leasable area at 2025-12-31 (about 50.5 million sq ft pro-rata). Money is rent: multi-year leases to grocers (Publix, Kroger, Albertsons, Whole Foods) and neighbourhood retailers with annual steps, plus recovery of property costs, with extra growth from redevelopment and new development, and management fees on joint-venture properties. The portfolio was 96.1 percent leased at 2025-12-31 and 96.5 percent at 2026-06-30, and 2025 revenue was $1,553.5M (+7 percent).

businessLines.name: Grocery-anchored shopping centers
businessLines.how: Retail tenants pay monthly base rent under multi-year leases with contractual steps, plus reimbursement of common-area maintenance, taxes and insurance; Regency lifts income by re-leasing at higher rents (positive rent spreads of 10.8% on 2025 renewals and new leases), redevelopment and acquisitions, and earns asset-management and other fees from partnership-owned centers.
businessLines.description: 481 properties, about 58.4M sq ft GLA (50.5M pro-rata) with equity interests, owned directly or through unconsolidated real estate partnerships; plus development and redevelopment projects. The 10-K text read does not split revenue into separate reportable segments.

revenue.note: Total revenues $1,553.5M vs $1,453.9M in FY2024; net income attributable to common shareholders $513.8M vs $386.7M
